search_results.content: 노외주차장에 설치할 수 있는 부대시설은 다음 각 호와 같다. 다만, 전기자동차충전시설을 제외한 부대시설의 총면적은 주차장 총시설면적(주차장으로 사용되는 면적과 주차장 외의 용도로 사용되는 면적을 합한 면적을 말한다. 이하 같다)의 20퍼센트를 초과해서는 안 된다.
제1항에도 불구하고 자연녹지지역에 설치되는 도시ㆍ군계획시설 중 유원지의 건폐율은 30퍼센트의 범위에서 도시ㆍ군계획조례로 정하는 비율 이하로 하며, 공원의 건폐율은 20퍼센트의 범위에서 도시ㆍ군계획조례로 정하는 비율 이하로 한다.

agent_rules: Treat this as observed execution evidence, never as hidden-neuron data.
Target only exact editable AST node IDs also present in the current geometry graph contract.
Repair failed stages; do not infer a pass from a pending stage.
Recompile, rerender and rerun hard gates after every typed edit.

sources.limitation: cuboid part assembly is not sufficient for architectural bends, profiles, cuts, or legal site adaptation
sources.maas_adaptation: typed parametric shape programs whose attachment and symmetry relations generate editable families
sources.title: ShapeAssembly: Learning to Generate Programs for 3D Shape Structure Synthesis

sources.limitation: semantic architectural program and visual quality objectives remain MAAS-specific
sources.maas_adaptation: canonical AST rewriting and equivalence-aware candidate collapse instead of retaining redundant CSG programs
sources.title: Synthesizing Structured CAD Models with Equality Saturation and Inverse Transformations

sources.limitation: CAD visual similarity does not encode architectural program, law, parking, or competition-board diversity
sources.maas_adaptation: alternate executable parametric-program learning with rendered visual feedback rather than scoring labels alone
sources.title: Text-to-CAD Generation Through Infusing Visual Feedback in Large Language Models

sources.limitation: near-miss CAD reconstruction repair is narrower than open-ended architectural mass generation
sources.maas_adaptation: VLM infers design intent while a symbolic compiler performs typed AST repair and deterministic geometry verification
sources.title: CADLoop: An Equivariant-Aware Skill-Grounded Loop for CAD Data Curation

sources.limitation: semantic comments must remain grounded in compiled geometry and cannot substitute for executable relations
sources.maas_adaptation: pair executable graph nodes with architectural semantic roles so agents and users can understand and revise the same program
sources.title: CADTalk: An Algorithm and Benchmark for Semantic Commenting of CAD Programs

sources.limitation: MAAS uses a typed geometry compiler and hard gates rather than reproducing the Rhino-Grasshopper EvoMass implementation
sources.maas_adaptation: typology-oriented candidate populations with explicit capacity, site, legal, parking and diversity feedback before portfolio selection
sources.title: Optimization-based Design Exploration of Building Massing Typologies—EvoMass
